'''Bez Martilla''' was one of the [[Slayers Three]], a trio of big-game hunters from a world within the [[Spawn Nebula/Legends|Spawn Nebula]], along with her brothers [[Angol Martilla|Angol]] and [[Derrus Martilla|Derrus]]. The three siblings regularly left their home and ventured out into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of the glory of the hunt; they followed an unknown calendar system and traveled to worlds decreed by their [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]]. Around [[3637 BBY]], the trio arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], though by this time Derrus has grown cynical and referred to his siblings as "idiots", abandoning the hunt. Meanwhile, Bez set out hunting on the [[Sky Ridge Island]], welcoming passing individuals to join the hunt.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bez Martilla and the Slayers Three appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
